selected.question: should you pay off a 6% mortgage early or invest the cash instead?

claims.statement: The comparison is after-tax mortgage rate versus after-tax expected return, not headline rate versus market average.
At a 6% loan and a 7% expected return, investing wins by about 1.1% per year before sequence risk.
Paying down debt wins once the guaranteed rate exceeds the after-tax return you can defend.
The decision flips again inside five years of retirement, when sequence-of-returns risk dominates.
